argv: () => {const c=document.querySelector("canvas");if(!c||c.width<200||c.height<100)throw Error("PDF not rendered");const d=c.getContext("2d").getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data;let dark=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4)if(d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2]<500&&d[i+3]>0)dark++;if(dark<20)throw Error("blank PDF");return {w:c.width,h:c.height,darkPixels:dark}}
